components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a route, form, or confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.5rem); corner-shape: squircle; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)); color: var(--primary-foreground, white); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2 / 0.9)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that stays quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.5rem); corner-shape: squircle; background: var(--background, white); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.002 162.2)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2 / 0.9)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact financial entry field with an explicit focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.5rem); corner-shape: squircle; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.016 162.2)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2 / 0.9)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Small primary status or category label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; height: 1.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)); color: var(--primary-foreground, white); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet route navigation with an understated active state.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; corner-shape: squircle; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.965 0.002 162.2)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); } .ds-nav-item-active { font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex: none; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The signature border-led financial work surface.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--background, white); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); text-align: left; } .ds-table th { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.002 162.2)) 40%, transparent); font-weight: 500; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.002 162.2)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-table .ds-amount { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(24rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; corner-shape: squircle; background: var(--popover, white); color: var(--popover-foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)) 10%, transparent), 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0.55 0.012 162.2 / 0.1); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.016 162.2)); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0 -1rem -1rem; padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); border-radius: 0 0 0.75rem 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0.002 162.2)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-dialog button { height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; corner-shape: squircle; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.925 0.004 162.2)); background: var(--background, white); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.25 0.023 162.2)); } .ds-dialog-delete { border: 1px solid transparent; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.584 0.239 28.5)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.584 0.239 28.5)); } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.476 0.078 162.2)) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Zai is a calm, private place to do consequential financial work. Its visual system pairs compact desktop utility with softened squircle geometry, a low-chroma ledger-green axis, and generous white or near-black canvases. The interface feels quiet rather than sparse: information remains dense where the task demands it, while color and elevation stay understated.

The system is neither neon fintech nor decorative glass. It communicates trust through legible data, stable spatial patterns, precise borders, and restrained state changes. Rounded Nova/Base UI primitives soften the tool without making it toy-like; tables, drawers, filters, and confirmations remain unmistakably operational.
keyCharacteristics: Low-chroma Ledger Green carried through actions, charts, and tinted neutrals
Geist body typography with Mona Sans reserved for the larger heading scale
Compact 32px controls with gentle squircle corners
Full-height desktop shell with a collapsible sidebar and fixed 48px route bar
Dense, border-led data surfaces with tabular numbers and quiet hover states
Layered overlays above flat work surfaces, with complete light/dark token parity

rules.name: The One Hue Axis Rule
rules.body: Product chrome and charts stay on the 162.2° ledger hue axis; category colors and Audit Red may break it only when they carry real semantic data.

rules.name: The No Neon Rule
rules.body: Never increase the accent into electric green, cyan, or a glowing fintech gradient. Ledger Green is muted on purpose.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce frosted cards, glossy panes, or translucent content surfaces. The current translucent select/menu treatment is an implementation exception, not a system pattern to propagate.

rules.name: The Data Stays Numeric Rule
rules.body: Right-align financial amounts and use tabular figures. Never rely on font weight or color alone to distinguish positive, negative, pending, or failed values.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Mona Sans is for the larger heading scale; Geist owns all operational text. Do not add a decorative display face or use monospace as fintech decoration.

rules.name: The Work Surface Stays Flat Rule
rules.body: Never place resting shadows on tables, filters, route sections, or routine form containers. Borders and tonal separation are sufficient.

rules.name: The Layer Must Earn Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the surface is temporarily above another surface. Remove the shadow when that interaction layer closes.

dos: Do use Ledger Green as a quiet semantic anchor for primary action, focus, and data continuity.
Do keep routine controls at 32px and default operational text at 14px.
Do use borders, muted bands, and whitespace to organize tables and forms.
Do reserve shadows for temporary interaction layers.
Do preserve equal information hierarchy and token parity in dark mode.
Do let feature-owned category colors carry meaning without recoloring the surrounding product chrome.
donts: Don't introduce neon green, cyan glows, gradient text, or luminous fintech effects.
Don't propagate glassmorphism, frosted cards, glossy panels, or translucent content surfaces.
Don't wrap every route section or table in a rounded card.
Don't use a shadow on a resting data surface.
Don't make financial data smaller than 12px or encode meaning through color alone.
Don't replace compact utility with oversized marketing typography inside the application shell.
